Author: Parth Prateem Sahu
Bench: Parth Prateem Sahu
 
 
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Mcrc No. 8946 of 2023

Nikhil Jindal S/o Late Hari Jindal Aged About 33 Years  R/o A- 29, Fourth Floor, Ganesh Nagar, Police Station- Shakarpur,
 East Delhi, District : East *, Delhi  ---
 Versus   State Of Chhattisgarh Through State Cyber Police Station, Nawa  Raipur,, District : Raipur, Chhattisgarh  ---- Respondent
For Applicant : Mr. Shobhit Koshta, Advocate For Respondent/State : Mr. Neeraj Sharma, Dy. Adv. General.
Hon'ble Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board 17/01/2024 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail to him as he is in custody in connection with Crime No.01/2023 registered at Police Station-State Cyber Police Station Nawa Raipur, (C.G.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 120B, 34 of Indian Penal Code & Section 66D of I.T. Act.

entities.text: Police Station-State Cyber Police Station Nawa Raipur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the applicant submits that she may be permitted to withdraw this bail application, at this stage, with liberty to file repeat application for grant of regular bail to the applicant at appropriate stage.
3. In view of the above, this M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.

Sd/-
